name: What is the process for upgrading light switches with a contractor in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for upgrading light switches with a contractor in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation where we assess your current setup and discuss your accessibility needs. We'll recommend suitable switch types and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, our licensed electricians will schedule the installation, performing the work efficiently and safely. We ensure minimal disruption and conduct a final walkthrough to confirm everything meets your expectations and local electrical codes in areas like Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, assessment, estimate, scheduled installation by licensed electricians, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction and code compliance.
